title: 2022 CODATA: vacuum electric permittivity is 8.854 187 8188 × 10^−12
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives vacuum electric permittivity as 8.854 187 8188 × 10^−12 F m^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 0014 × 10^−12 F m^-1.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives vacuum electric permittivity as 8.854 187 8188 × 10^−12 F m^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 0014 × 10^−12 F m^-1. The row is not marked exact. The 2022 listing gives the vacuum electric permittivity with an uncertainty and does not mark it exact.
